# Non-Obvious Constraints
<!-- docs.AI knowledge doc — auto-generated by speckit.init -->

## Multi-Tenancy Assumption

**All projects are assumed scoped (multi-tenant) by default.** Skills explicitly check at every layer:
- Every query must include a scope filter (tenant_id, user_id, org_id)
- No global data unless explicitly declared
- `ai-radija-bootstrap` mandates soft-delete + audit fields on all tables

---

## Radija Transversal Rules (ai-radija-bootstrap)

These 14 rules are enforced for all Radija projects. Violations block or warn at bootstrap time.

| Rule | Enforcement | Impact |
|------|-------------|--------|
| Secrets → Vault (Azure Key Vault / AWS Secrets Manager) | **HARD BLOCK** | Refuses to generate if violations exist |
| Code language = English (identifiers, comments, docs) | **SOFT BLOCK** | Requests written justification (ADR) |
| Auth = SSO (Azure AD, Okta, B2C) — no custom auth | **SOFT BLOCK** | Requests justification |
| Observability required (logs, metrics, traces) | **SOFT BLOCK** | Blocks if no observability configured |
| Data residency must match hosting country | **SOFT BLOCK** | Warns if hosting region ≠ data country |
| ORM preference = Dapper + Stored Procedures (over EF Core) | **SOFT BLOCK** | Warning; requests rationale if EF Core used |
| Password hashing = Argon2id | **SOFT BLOCK** | Blocks if bcrypt/SHA used directly |
| No entity exposure (DTOs only at API boundaries) | **SOFT BLOCK** | Warns on direct entity serialization |
| UTC for all backend timestamps | **SOFT BLOCK** | Warns on non-UTC datetime fields |
| Soft delete required (no hard deletes) | **HARD BLOCK** | Refuses schema without `deleted_at` |
| Audit fields required (`created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`) | **HARD BLOCK** | Refuses schema without audit fields |

## Compliance Regulations (Country-Specific)

Templates in `skills/ai-radija-bootstrap/templates/regulations/`:

| Country | Regulation | Key Requirement |
|---------|-----------|----------------|
| Brazil | LGPD | Data minimization, consent, right to erasure |
| Mexico | LFPDPPP | Notice, consent, data transfer restrictions |
| Colombia | Ley 1581 | Authorization, purpose limitation, data quality |

## Platform Constraints

- **Claude Code is primary** — Codex and Antigravity support is present but less tested
- **Notion integration uses undocumented endpoints** — may drift across API versions
- **No Codex/Antigravity parity guarantee** — some skills may not behave identically outside Claude Code
- **Session state is ephemeral** — `specs/feature.json` is the only persisted session pointer; everything else must be re-read at session start

---

## State Management Constraints

- **Session-scoped**: active feature directory resolved from `specs/feature.json` at skill invocation time
- **Project-scoped**: tracker config, templates, constitution live in `CLAUDE.md` (persisted)
- **No cross-project state**: each repo has isolated context; no shared state between projects

---

## Known Limitations / TODOs

- Stack-bootstrap tooling (`ai-radija-bootstrap`) is a separate skill from the generic pack — its compliance/regulatory templates assume a bootstrapped project structure and may not apply to other contexts without modification
- `ai-radija-generate-pre-knowledge-docs` is not a registered Claude Code skill at the plugin level; it must be invoked via the `speckit.generate-pre-knowledge-docs` wrapper or executed manually
- Codex CLI and Antigravity adapters exist but documentation for them is thinner than Claude Code docs
- Linear integration depends on Linear MCP being configured; fallback to API key requires manual setup

---

## Versioning Constraint

Template format is **frozen in v2.x**. Any change to the `templates/*.md` structure (new required sections, renamed headings) is a breaking change requiring a major version bump. Skills may add optional sections but must not remove existing ones.
